say:1:1541102001:1.text: You want to hear stories about yourself?
say:1:1541102001:1.source_cn: 你想知道关于自己的传说？
say:1:1541102001:1.male: You want to hear stories about yourself?
say:1:1541102001:1.female: You want to hear stories about yourself?

say:2:1541102002:1.text: Surely a god knows his own myths better than we do.
say:2:1541102002:1.male: Surely a god knows his own myths better than we do.
say:2:1541102002:1.female: Surely a goddess knows her own myths better than we do.

choice_prompt:3:1541102002.text: Surely a god knows his own myths better than we do.
choice_prompt:3:1541102002.male: Surely a god knows his own myths better than we do.
choice_prompt:3:1541102002.female: Surely a goddess knows her own myths better than we do.

say:5:1541102004:1.text: Still, if the Herdmaster asks, I will obey.
say:5:1541102004:1.source_cn: 总之，既然是神的命令，我会遵从。
say:5:1541102004:1.male: Still, if the Herdmaster asks, I will obey.
say:5:1541102004:1.female: Still, if the Herdmaster asks, I will obey.

say:6:1541102005:1.text: Legend says that in the age of chaos, when no humans walked the earth and only beasts roamed, you, the Herdmaster, reigned as their ruler.
say:6:1541102005:1.source_cn: 传说，在世界混沌，没有人，只有兽的时代，狩猎神是野兽的主宰。
say:6:1541102005:1.male: Legend says that in the age of chaos, when no humans walked the earth and only beasts roamed, you, the Herdmaster, reigned as their ruler.
say:6:1541102005:1.female: Legend says that in the age of chaos, when no humans walked the earth and only beasts roamed, you, the Herdmaster, reigned as their ruler.

say:7:1541102006:1.text: But beasts were simple: they hunted, they slept, they bred. None could worship. There were only prey—no worthy hunters. It displeased you.
say:7:1541102006:1.source_cn: 野兽不够聪明，只知捕食、休息、繁衍，不懂得侍奉神。只有...
say:7:1541102006:1.male: But beasts were simple: they hunted, they slept, they bred. None could worship. There were only prey—no worthy hunters. It displeased you.
say:7:1541102006:1.female: But beasts were simple: they hunted, they slept, they bred. None could worship. There were only prey—no worthy hunters. It displeased you.

say:8:1541102007:1.text: And so, the Wildborn were born.
say:8:1541102007:1.male: And so, the Wildborn were born.
say:8:1541102007:1.female: And so, the Wildborn were born.

choice_prompt:9:1541102007.text: And so, the Wildborn were born.
choice_prompt:9:1541102007.male: And so, the Wildborn were born.
choice_prompt:9:1541102007.female: And so, the Wildborn were born.

say:10:1541102008:1.text: Because it's the first word you ever spoke aloud.
say:10:1541102008:1.source_cn: 雅库伯尔，是从你口中吐露的第一个词。
say:10:1541102008:1.male: Because it's the first word you ever spoke aloud.
say:10:1541102008:1.female: Because it's the first word you ever spoke aloud.

say:11:1541102009:1.text: The oldest records say it carried your hopes for us.
say:11:1541102009:1.source_cn: 在最久远的记载里，它象征着神对信徒的期盼。
say:11:1541102009:1.male: The oldest records say it carried your hopes for us.
say:11:1541102009:1.female: The oldest records say it carried your hopes for us.

say:12:1541102010:1.text: To be strong, fierce, swift, and brave.
say:12:1541102010:1.male: To be strong, fierce, swift, and brave.
say:12:1541102010:1.female: To be strong, fierce, swift, and brave.

say:13:1541102011:1.text: So our ancestors took the name "Wildborn" and prayed for your blessing.
say:13:1541102011:1.source_cn: 因此，先祖选择雅库伯尔作为名号，通过祭祀请求你的庇护。
say:13:1541102011:1.male: So our ancestors took the name "Wildborn" and prayed for your blessing.
say:13:1541102011:1.female: So our ancestors took the name "Wildborn" and prayed for your blessing.

say:14:1541102012:1.text: For seven days they offered tribute, and finally, on the night of the Blood Moon, you came and granted us your blessing.
say:14:1541102012:1.source_cn: 经过七天的奉纳，神在一个血月降临，同意了我等先祖的请求...
say:14:1541102012:1.male: For seven days they offered tribute, and finally, on the night of the Blood Moon, you came and granted us your blessing.
say:14:1541102012:1.female: For seven days they offered tribute, and finally, on the night of the Blood Moon, you came and granted us your blessing.

say:15:1541102013:1.text: O mighty Herdmaster—this is how you earned the title "Wild Moon."
say:15:1541102013:1.source_cn: 伟大的狩猎神啊！这便是你的尊号——雅库伯尔之月的由来。
say:15:1541102013:1.male: O mighty Herdmaster—this is how you earned the title "Wild Moon."
say:15:1541102013:1.female: O mighty Herdmaster—this is how you earned the title "Wild Moon."

say:16:1541102014:1.text: May your blessing keep our spears forever sharp, O god!
say:16:1541102014:1.source_cn: 保佑雅库伯尔的矛永远锋利吧，神！
say:16:1541102014:1.male: May your blessing keep our spears forever sharp, O god!
say:16:1541102014:1.female: May your blessing keep our spears forever sharp, O goddess!

choice:3:0:1.text: I want to hear your version.
choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 想听听你们的版本，不行吗？
choice:3:0:1.male: I want to hear your version.
choice:3:0:1.female: I want to hear your version.
